BiblicalUsage: Siniazo means to sift, as wheat in a sieve, and it appears once, on the night of the betrayal: Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat. The Lord warned Peter that the sifting was coming, and He prayed that his faith would not fail.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Satan's sifting is real, and so is the Lord's prayer, because Jesus warned Peter of the sieve and then prayed him through it.
